name: Commune with Nature

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Learn three facts of your choice about the land around you.
text: The area is 3 miles around you outdoors or 300 feet underground; facts can be terrain, waters, plants, animals, creatures, planar influences or buildings. It doesn't work where nature has been replaced by construction, such as a dungeon or town.
